commits.summary: Discover public entries and bind their original ordered deployments (verification pending)
commits.body:
Stage 3 and the change planner now resolve each public selector against its original JVM and the native checker, keeping the original client, upgrade operand and entry provider separate. Preserve the full search order in property recipes, resolve signed local manifest layouts and their absences, and record per-side binding, cache and original-call evidence. Historical debugger receipts retain their original tool identities.

Log4j's two unchanged questions reached core at position one and all eight finite inputs matched. The first unaided ranking put getNextTime second of 22. The frozen Parquet transfer scanned 114 distinct artifacts and found three changed writer declarations, missing the higher-level file history. All 283 historical class origins on 21 graphs matched. Checked recursive manifest, missing-descriptor, order, and eight multi-release controls. The changed suite passed 55 of 57 on the first attempt, then both corrected suites passed separately.

Verification jobs 20261126-200411-qualify-the-captured-deployment-layouts, 20261126-200411-replay-log4j-public-entry-bindings-and-s and 20261126-200854-verify-the-helper-chosen-by-ordinary-ord repeat the signed release panel, same-path replays and actual backend sentinels.

commits.summary: Qualify public callers, observable resources and scoped reuse (verification pending)
commits.body:
Attach each original JVM witness to its own frozen question, trace the runtime receiver and changed-body stack, and carry saved scaffold identities into proof recipes and an offline receipt reader. Recheck declared absences and file identities before publishing. The physical index shares archived manifest contents across revisions and distinguishes accessible public factories and shadowed selector changes.

The two unaided facade candidates both reached the private helper, and the unrelated method stayed out. The resource generator recovered Annotation Indexer including in provider two and identified Batik's distinct service iterator. Original controls reproduced the eight optional-provider transitions, all ten Parquet histories and their reversed orders, the erased bridge, four nonzero invoices under reversal, eight JDK 17/21 multi-release views, and isolated context resources. All 58 selected suites passed. The first native and stock JBMC sentinel job passed all twelve positive and negative assertions.

The first Log4j and panel jobs exposed the shared-entry witness labeling error. Jobs 20261126-201852-recheck-all-twelve-release-questions-wit and 20261126-201853-recheck-both-log4j-claim-witnesses-acros repeat their independent checks after repair. Job 20261126-202434-carry-staged-entry-records-into-native-a exercises the actual staged proof routes and repeats the strict scheduling boundary.
